Container.Name: deck-lotus
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted Magic: The Gathering deck builder and collection manager. Card data comes from MTGJSON and is synced weekly; prices refresh daily.
Before first start, set JWT Secret to a long random string and change the admin password. The first startup downloads and imports MTGJSON card data, which takes several minutes.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, backups and card data. Keep this on a persistent share.

Config.Name: JWT Secret
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Long random string used to sign logins. Changing it signs everyone out. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Admin Username
Config.Description: Admin account created on first startup if none exists.

Config.Name: Admin Email
Config.Description: Email for the first-run admin account.

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Password for the first-run admin account. Only used when no admin exists yet. Leave blank to have one generated and printed to the container log.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone for the weekly card sync, daily price refresh and backups (e.g. America/New_York). Without it schedules run in UTC.

Config.Name: Mana Pool Email
Config.Description: Optional. Mana Pool account email. Needs the API token too, or the integration stays off.

Config.Name: Mana Pool API Token
Config.Description: Optional. From manapool.com/seller/settings/integrations. Needs the email too.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: Optional. ntfy server for price-alert push notifications.

Config.Name: ntfy Topic
Config.Description: Optional. Unique ntfy topic name. Can also be set and tested in Settings, which takes precedence.

Config.Name: ntfy Token
Config.Description: Optional. Access token for a protected ntfy topic.

Config.Name: Force Reimport
Config.Description: Set to true to force a full MTGJSON reimport on next start. User data is preserved. Set back to false afterwards.

Config.Name: TCGPlayer Client ID
Config.Description: Optional legacy price fallback. Keys are no longer publicly issued.
